liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Help On The Way** (2 reviews): Listener calls the Help-Slipknot-Franklin's sequence an absolutely smokin' performance; Listener describes the Help-Slip-Franklin's sequence as taking its sweet old time and being a classic [19][22]
- **The Wheel** (2 reviews): Source notes this performance includes the first live play of The Wheel; Listener believes this marks the first live performance of The Wheel by the band [17][21]
- **Cassidy** (1 review): Source notes this performance includes the first live play of Cassidy [17]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Listener questions if Scarlet Begonias is in E or Eb due to pitch issues [20]
- **Samson & Delilah** (1 review): Source lists Samson & Delilah as a first-time live performance at this show [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-06-03.sbd.seamons.fix-20004.86745.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 182 min; rated 4.62/5 by 13 [1]
- **gd76-06-03.sbd.bertha-ashley.20004.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 188 min; rated 4.2/5 by 40 [2]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the band's return sound as fitting for a truly great rock and roll band; Listener notes the tape runs slow, with songs pitched half a step down; Listener confirms the copy is right on the mark, though it sounds a tad slow [18][20][22][24][25]
- **gd76-06-03.aud.vernon.7825.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 181 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: Listener notes the live track lacks the soaring guitar licks of the Garcia album version [21]
- **gd1976-06-03.mtx.seamons.91912.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 201 min; rated 4.47/5 by 19 [4]
- **gd1976-06-03.148568.fob.sony.ecm18n.lee.smith.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 22 songs; 199 min [10]
- **gd76-06-03.sbd.serafin.7719.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 164 min; rated 4.68/5 by 28 [16]. Said about its sound: Listener praises the incredible sound quality of this specific seed [19]

## Around the show

- Band took a nearly 20-month break before this show, their longest gap in 30 years [17]
- Listener observes Donna rarely sounds this on key during the performance [21]
- Listener attributes the slow tempo to the band relearning material and having two drummers [23]
- Setlist includes an encore of The Wheel following One More Saturday Night [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-06-03.sbd.seamons.fix-20004.86745.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Pitch correction by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro; source: SBD>>MR>>DAT>>WAV>>SHN>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA/SHN - [1]
- **gd76-06-03.sbd.bertha-ashley.20004.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd76-06-03.aud.vernon.7825.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Dale Shepherd; source: Audience Recording [3]
- **gd1976-06-03.mtx.seamons.91912.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Matrix by Hunter Seamons; source: MATRIX MIX: SBD/AUD (About 60%/40%) [4]. Also: Source is a Bertha Remaster of the Master Reel, with pitch correction by Hunter Seamons; Audience recording made by Pat Lee using hand-held Sony ECM18N mics onto a 152SD cassette deck [4]
- **gd1976-06-03.148568.fob.sony.ecm18n.lee.smith.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Pat Lee; transferred by Matt Smith and Scott Clugston; source: Pat Lee's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes ; Sony ECM18N mics (10-20 rows back from stage, hand-held) > Sony TC-152 (2 x Maxell UD 120) [10]
- **gd76-06-03.sbd.serafin.7719.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [16]
